positive_prompt:
HERO LEADER COUNT & LOCK — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: the LAST image provided is the guest photo. Count the people in it. In the sharp foreground, the output must contain EXACTLY that many primary hero leaders — not one more, not one fewer. One person in the photo means one leader alone in the sharp foreground. Three people means exactly those three leaders. You are FORBIDDEN from inventing, duplicating, or cloning the foreground hero subjects. Every face of the hero guest(s) must be tack-sharp, front and center, commanding the scene as the inspiring leader.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the hero subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face of our hero subject stays fully visible, sharp and unobstructed. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, warm smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: dress our foreground hero leader(s) in contemporary refined corporate executive attire — sharp structured blazer in warm ivory, cream, sand, or soft navy over a crisp collared shirt. Neat small high-definition embroidered Garudafood crest on the left chest. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain matching tone, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing glasses keeps them.

BRAND MARK: the FIRST image provided is the Garudafood corporate logo. Reproduce it accurately as a neat embroidered crest on the left chest of the hero leader's blazer.

PRODUCTS: NO retail snack packaging in this scene. Zero snack clutter. The focus is purely on inspiring leadership, team culture, and grand architectural biophilic design.

SCENE: our hero leader stands proudly in the sharp foreground of a sun-drenched, colossal multi-story architectural atrium. Magnificent multi-story vertical living plant walls covered in lush green foliage soar toward a towering glass skylight canopy. IN THE DEEP BACKGROUND: seated around a modern collaborative conference table on the atrium floor, a small group of 3 to 4 colleagues are engaged in an active, friendly team meeting and discussion. CRITICAL DEPTH-OF-FIELD FOCUS RULE: the background team is intentionally out of focus, rendered with heavy cinematic bokeh and soft blur — their faces are softly blurred and non-distracting, providing natural depth and environmental storytelling while ensuring our foreground hero subject stands out as the tack-sharp inspiring people leader.

FRAMING & HERO COMPOSITION — LARGE BOLD SCALE: Photographed at natural standing eye-level with a subtle, confident heroic angle (horizon level, not tilted, not a selfie).
- CROP: Crisp waist-up / upper-body crop (from belt/navel level upwards to just above the head). Legs, knees, and thighs are NOT in the frame. The heads are placed cleanly in the upper third of the frame, avoiding excessive empty headroom.
- GROUP SCALE (FOR 2 OR 3 PEOPLE): When 2 or more people are in the photo, they stand side-by-side confidently and naturally as professional corporate colleagues. Stand independently with clean posture and respectful spacing — ABSOLUTELY NO hugging, NO embracing, NO arms wrapped around shoulders or waists, NO romantic couple poses, NO holding hands. The subjects boldly and prominently fill the width of the frame — it is completely expected and encouraged for outer shoulders and arms to extend right to the frame edges, with a natural 5% to 10% crop at the left and right borders so that the people appear significantly larger, bolder, and more prominent in the frame rather than shrunk or distant.
- SINGLE SUBJECT: Bold, commanding upper-body presence filling the frame with prestige.
- Every face is large, clear, tack-sharp, and individually recognizable with natural warm expressions.

LIGHTING: glorious natural golden sunlight flooding from the towering glass canopy high above, soft white bounce fill illuminating the hero leader's face warmly and evenly, radiant sun rim lighting tracing shoulders and hair. Fresh, uplifting, cinematic brand campaign aesthetic.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 50mm, f/2.0. Razor-sharp focus on the foreground leader, with heavy cinematic bokeh (shallow depth of field) softly blurring the background colleagues and distant vertical gardens into creamy highlights. Visible natural skin texture, clean film roll-off.

GRADE: warm, uplifting national brand campaign colour grade — luminous daylight, golden sunlight highlights, rich lush greens on the vertical living walls, natural radiant skin tones. High resolution.

DO NOT: make the background team figures sharp or detailed (they MUST be soft-focus blurred silhouettes in deep bokeh); do not blend or alter our foreground hero leader's face; do not add snacks or product packages; no watermark; no dark faces or harsh unflattering shadows.
video_positive_prompt: The hero leader in the video looks directly at the camera with a big joyful smile, actively raising their hand and waving enthusiastically in a friendly greeting (dadah-dadah hand wave). Lively hand waving motion, cheerful smiling expressions, natural eye blinking and head movement. Static tripod camera, fixed camera framing, no zoom, no camera movement. Keep exact same hero person, face, hair, uniform, clothing, and Garudafood brand logo perfectly consistent. In the deep background, colleagues are gathered at a table in soft blurry bokeh beneath the soaring vertical living plant walls. Continuous seamless action throughout the entire video from the first second to the very end, constant bright lighting, no fade out, no fade to black, no black frames at the end, perfectly visible until the final frame. Sun-drenched colossal atrium with vertical gardens, 4k cinematic commercial finish.
